for: The presentation: a finding from growing a planting on the room, and the change to the building it led to. Not placed in the deck yet.
shows: The room and one patch of its roof, looked at squarely from outside. The planting grows for ten tended years; the joints the clinging plants reach are marked as they are reached; the lap is shown cut through, with a stem going into the gap beside the crossing member and thickening; then the same patch of roof as it is now cut, bare and with the ivy on it; and last which joints are reached in every run and which only in some.
statement: A growth scenario on stated assumptions, not a forecast. Concept geometry; trial planting.
